sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by rule,reference

sections.title: Outstanding promises
sections.sql: select number,vendor,source_id,promise_on,outstanding,late from v_balances where outstanding>0 order by promise_on nulls first,number

sections.title: Open supplier exposure
sections.sql: select name,currency,units_outstanding,late_lines,outstanding_cost_cents from v_supplier_review order by name,currency

sections.title: Snapshot review
sections.sql: select retailer_sku,vendor,available,stock_at,stale,active from v_stock order by retailer_sku,vendor
